name: algo-tally-connector
description: A working Tally <-> Algo Akanade integration: pulls ledger/voucher data from Tally's own XML HTTP gateway and forwards it to ALGO AKANADE's chat and Train Algo AI APIs. A concrete plugin for Tally (not a generic SDK), built on @algo-akanade/connector so the same pattern generalizes to other ERP/React/React Native apps.

scripts.package:linux: npm run build && pkg dist/src/cli.js --targets node18-linux-x64 --output dist-exe/AlgoAIForTally-linux
scripts.package:win: npm run build && pkg dist/src/cli.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist-exe/AlgoAIForTally-windows.exe
scripts.package:all: npm run package:linux && npm run package:win
